passages.text: He who once was heedless, but turned to heedfulness, shines upon this world, like the moon freed from clouds. Someone whose bad deed is supplanted by the good, shines upon this world, like the moon freed from clouds.
passages.note: Guilt and redemption; past wrongs need not define you

passages.text: For while irrigators guide water, fletchers bend arrows straight, and carpenters bend timber straight, the astute tame themselves.
